actual_arguments.prompt: Create one new unofficial Genius Invokation TCG character card illustration for Mitya from Genshin Impact. IMPORTANT REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1, the user's Mitya in-game model, supplies only character identity, face, hair, eyes, body proportions and exact costume. Image 2, the genuine Lisa Genius Invokation TCG card, is the PRIMARY ART-STYLE reference for the whole painted illustration, including how the character himself is drawn, not only the border or layout. Render Mitya as though illustrated by the same card artist in the same Genius Invokation set: delicate confident contours, flat graphic color shapes, selective crisp cel shadows, restrained soft shading, stylized simplified facial planes, decorative cut-paper-like silhouettes and elegant patterned negative space. Match the style reference's level of simplification, shape language, face rendering, texture and compact card composition. Avoid glossy splash-art rendering, photorealism, 3D model shading, heavily airbrushed gradients or over-detailed reflective surfaces. Do not depict Lisa or borrow her outfit, hat, hair, body or pose. Mitya has silver-white tousled hair, violet eyes, a slender petite Medium Male build, a friendly knowing smile, navy waistcoat and purple lapels over white cravat, the gold atom-shaped amber-and-cyan chest pendant, turquoise tassels, gold shoulder circles and gold arc motifs on his long dark coat. Preserve his model's exact costume identity while simplifying details in the TCG artist's visual language. Pose him in a natural graceful three-quarter stance with his left hand loosely by his hip and his right hand holding a small glowing orbital energy diagram near his chest. Large readable face; coherent hands with a palm, four fingers and separate thumb. Surround him with a FEW broad turquoise ribbons and elegant purple orbital motifs, arranged as flat layered graphic shapes, decorative rather than a storm of cinematic effects. Original composition, character fills most of card, showing head through lower legs. The complete slim cream-and-gold rounded rectangular frame should match the genuine reference, vertical card about 7:12 aspect ratio. One card, no text, title, numbers, stat icons, logos or watermark.
